about: Test description of the Baylor case. The answer key is answer_key.json (made from answer_sheet.doc); the lines, steps, and notes are in source/cases/baylor.js. This file tells the tests which PDF goes with each step.
pdfWhy: Step P has no printout of its own; its return is the same as Step O's.
todoWhy: Steps A, E, I, and N each leave one TS Note box for the student to tick.
ownTsNoteBoxWhy: Each of these steps keeps its own TS Note box: ticking one must not tick another.
